descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: re-save / re-tap.

Candidate N22 · proposed S1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Conditional and monitoring-phrased orders never become tasks ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4', 'trend his peak flows twice a day', 'check her BP twice daily, call me if under 100'); the extraction prompt still excludes them

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 3 (was decision D4) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: TFA-92592 AC 3 (ready for QA) answers D4: they must become tasks. Prompts are byte-identical to e02167f; dev drops them again.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-22/S01, TC-22/S03, TC-22/S07, TC-22/S15, TC-22/S25

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S11 Re-save and re-tap: pre-round Save Note and Save & Extract again add nothing and do not reopen closed tasks

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th … (UAT TC-22 step 1; TFA-92588 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient with the three UAT tasks added by hand (exact texts), so the start does not depend on the pre-round harvest

When A: Save Note on a pre-round note naming the same three tasks. B: Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text, then tap it again unchanged. C: Save Note on the unchanged pre-round note once more

Then A: still 3 pending, no second copy of any task. B: 2 pending, BMP and PT completed once. C: still 2 pending; BMP and PT still completed, not re-created as open tasks

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U3 as read in Q5 (a)–(c), on fixed strings only: the three tasks are typed, so their 'Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' names are exact; '2 pending tasks' = weight + the diet task, and any second copy or reopened task raises the count or brings back a 'Complete task:' name. A missing 'Reopen task: follow up BMP' is labelled with the UAT phrasing gap (Q7); …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)
